topic: Day 142 — reel — An emotion is information, not an instruction
text:
An emotion is
[information], not
an instruction.
caption:
Feeling something strongly doesn't obligate you to act on it in the next minute. It's data to read, not a command to follow.

Follow for one of these a day.
